messages:
erin: Customer ticket from Acme — large p99 spike after Thalia model onboarding. Only on long-context requests (>8k tokens). p95 looks fine. Raising here to triage. req id: req_0ab12c.

sam: Can you paste the p95/p99 numbers and a curl repro? Also which model variant and tokenizer tag did they land on?

erin: p95: 380ms, p99: 2100ms (baseline before was ~420ms). Error rate ~0.2% (timeouts). Model: thalia-v1.2 tokeniser: thalia-bpe-v2 (released during onboarding). Example curl we used to repro: 
```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"thalia-v1.2","input":"'"$(python - <<'PY'\nprint('A'*9000)\nPY)"'" , "max_tokens":512}'
```
(replaced with long A-run to hit long context)

sam: thanks — can you also pull a runtime trace (TRACE_KVCACHE=1) for one of the slow requests and include the decode/kv timings?

erin: attached from Acme's request id (server logs):
```
[2026-02-18T12:03:21Z] req_0ab12c: input_tokens=9123 decode_tokens=512
[2026-02-18T12:03:21Z] kvcache_hits=123 kvcache_misses=987 (miss_rate=88%)
[2026-02-18T12:03:23Z] decode_latency_ms=1820 total_latency_ms=2100
```

leo: hunch: thalia-bpe-v2 changed subword boundaries so average tokens per input increased and invalidated KV cache alignment across chunked requests — results in a lot more cache misses and re-encoding work. We saw similar in other onboardings when tokenization delta > ~6%. Can repro locally with our longctx harness.

marta: I ran the reproduce on staging with the same payload. Observed kvcache_miss_rate ~87% for seq>8k and backend_decode added ~1.7-1.9s. Immediate mitigation options: 
- route long-context traffic to thalia-compat (previous tokenizer)
- temporary rollback of tokenizer tag for thalia-v1.2 to thalia-bpe-v1
- enable prefix cache TTL extension (gives more time for cache to populate)
- add automatic small-chunk fallback to reduce cache fragmentation

marta: config snippet for routing in the console (canary):
```yaml
routes:
  - match: model==thalia-v1.2 && request.context_length>8000
    override_model: thalia-v1.2-compat
    reason: tokenizer-compatibility-circuit-breaker
```

priya: i'll take lead on customer comms. Proposed message: "We're aware of latency increase for very long inputs after Thalia onboarding. We are rolling a targeted compatibility route to restore prior latency while we investigate. ETA ~30 minutes." :hourglass_flowing_sand:

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for route override thalia-v1.2 -> thalia-v1.2-compat (canary group: 2% long-ctx traffic).

marta: Canary results at +12m: p99 for long-ctx group dropped from ~2.1s -> 430ms. KV miss rate down to 9% in canary. Monitoring for 30m.

erin: updated customer (Acme) with mitigation and repro steps. They've accepted routing workaround for now. Asking about credits.

sam: follow-ups: 
- add regression test in the onboarding CI that checks token_count_delta < 5% and kvcache_miss < 10% for a representative long-context sample
- pin default tokenizer in model manifest until compatibility tests pass
- add telemetry alert on per-model tokenization deltas post-deploy

leo: opened GH issue: "tokenizer-compatibility-flag+onboarding-checks" with repro, will link to infra ticket.

priya: thanks all — I'll keep customer updated and close after 3 successful 15m windows.

erin: closing loop here once deploy flagged green. thanks team. :white_check_mark:
